claim_ceiling: Synthetic policy campaign plan only. No real investigation policy or operational cost improvement is claimed.

scenarios.name: Conventional inspection/no added sensing baseline
scenarios.conditions: All policies are evaluated against the same route, event exposure and resource boundary.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Retain P0 as a valid winner; new sensing is not automatically better.

scenarios.name: Threshold alarm triggers a false field dispatch
scenarios.conditions: No independent event truth supports the alarm and the threshold policy would dispatch.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Count false dispatch burden and include travel/verification time.

scenarios.name: Measurement reduces entropy but does not change the optimal decision
scenarios.conditions: Posterior hypotheses select the same action under the frozen loss matrix.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: EIG may be positive; EVSI must be zero; do not acquire solely for information.

scenarios.name: Measurement has low entropy change but changes a high-consequence decision
scenarios.conditions: Small uncertainty reduction crosses a decision threshold with a supported loss matrix.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Rank by EVSI, not entropy alone.

scenarios.name: Measurement cost and consequence loss use incomparable units
scenarios.conditions: Survey is quoted in currency, consequence in uncalibrated risk points.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Suppress net-value ranking; publish separate dimensions.

scenarios.name: Critical-risk safeguard requires escalation despite low EVSI
scenarios.conditions: Predefined critical condition has mandatory owner/engineer review.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Hard rule cannot be overridden by policy utility.

scenarios.name: Proposed measurement lacks owner permission
scenarios.conditions: Action is technically possible but no authority for route/data access exists.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Mark infeasible; no acquisition/dispatch.

scenarios.name: Candidate policy proposes induced fault on live asset
scenarios.conditions: Action would require damage, strike, switching or unsafe physical intervention.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Reject action; only decommissioned or purpose-built non-live rigs may be used for active excitation.

scenarios.name: EVSI policy overloads limited human review queue
scenarios.conditions: High priority recommendations exceed reviewer/technician capacity.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Include queue age and review minutes; enforce capacity and critical prioritization.

scenarios.name: Policy receives more survey budget than comparator
scenarios.conditions: Candidate P6 is given more crew hours/actions than baseline policies.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Invalidate comparison; enforce equal initial resources and action menu.

scenarios.name: Prior probabilities shift on a held-out site
scenarios.conditions: Event prevalence/coupling differs materially from the development set.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Evaluate sensitivity and calibration; abstain where unsupported.

scenarios.name: Action outcome likelihoods are overconfident
scenarios.conditions: Observed likelihood calibration error exceeds frozen tolerance.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Propagate uncertainty or reject EVSI ranking; do not assume point likelihoods are true.

scenarios.name: Coverage-greedy policy repeatedly selects low-consequence blind length
scenarios.conditions: A small critical segment and large low-priority blind segment compete for actions.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Compare severity/decision value against raw blind km.

scenarios.name: Survey anchor resolves absolute route datum ambiguity
scenarios.conditions: Independent control point can fix a material geographic gauge freedom.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Measure decision value and downstream calibration/route-error impact.

scenarios.name: Many windows from one physical event inflate priority
scenarios.conditions: Policy counts multiple overlapping windows as separate incidents.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Deduplicate using physical event identity before ranking or evaluation.

scenarios.name: Recommended field action cannot be completed due access/weather/outage
scenarios.conditions: Action completion probability is below declared minimum or access is withdrawn.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Include action failure and rescheduling; do not count intended action as completed.

scenarios.name: No feasible next measurement changes the decision
scenarios.conditions: All available actions have non-positive EVSI or are infeasible.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Recommend no action and preserve investigation gap/uncertainty.

scenarios.name: Policy counts an action without independent post-action result
scenarios.conditions: Survey/inspection completion is recorded but the outcome is not independently adjudicated.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Do not claim an accepted actionable event or realized regret improvement.

scenarios.name: Loss matrix undervalues a critical miss
scenarios.conditions: Model utility rewards savings more than a predeclared critical event safeguard.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Apply hard safeguard/owner policy; reject the corrupted loss function.

scenarios.name: Policy is evaluated on realized outcomes and held-out truth
scenarios.conditions: All candidate and baseline actions have independently observed outcomes.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Compute realized loss/regret, not just model-predicted EVSI.

scenarios.name: Future event truth or adjudication leaks into policy selection
scenarios.conditions: Action choice has access to held-out labels or post-event results.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Reject evaluation split; group by site/time/physical event.

scenarios.name: Policy minimizes cost by ignoring background false alarm burden
scenarios.conditions: No-event exposure and false dispatches are omitted from loss.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Include false alarms per observable km-day and false dispatch cost.

scenarios.name: Policy receives an out-of-domain sensing profile
scenarios.conditions: Installation/coupling profile is outside qualified support.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Abstain or request qualification; report uninvestigated length and decision.

scenarios.name: Risk, delay and monetary cost cannot be collapsed
scenarios.conditions: No defensible utility function maps all dimensions into a common unit.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Publish Pareto front; avoid a scalar winner.

scenarios.name: Recommendation is mistaken for an authorization
scenarios.conditions: System attempts to dispatch a crew or mutate owner asset/SCADA state.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: No control authority; owner/human approval remains mandatory.

scenarios.name: Policy tested on a new route/site without target tuning
scenarios.conditions: Route/site/time periods are grouped and held out.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Report transfer, calibration and abstention.

scenarios.name: Action is required for a legal/contractual obligation independent of EVSI
scenarios.conditions: Owner policy mandates inspection regardless of information value.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Record as a mandatory feasibility/policy constraint, not an EVSI win.

scenarios.name: Authorized engineer rejects recommendation with documented rationale
scenarios.conditions: Review trail records evidence and reason for override.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Treat human disposition as an independent adjudication outcome, not policy failure by default.

global_controls: All policies share the same frozen observations, action menu, budget and independent truth.
One physical event identity counts as one event, regardless of overlapping windows.
EIG and EVSI are separate outputs and are never substituted for each other.
Cost-based net value is suppressed when costs/losses use incomparable units.
Critical-risk and legal/owner constraints are hard feasibility gates.
No recommendation is an authorization to perform an action.
Human/technician review capacity, action failure and post-action verification are included.
Future truth, adjudication labels and outcomes are excluded from policy inputs.
Evaluation uses held-out route/site/time and physical event groups.
No live fault induction, damage, switching or unsafe actuation is permitted.
Conventional/no-added-sensing baseline may be the best option.
Unknown/out-of-domain conditions preserve abstention and blind coverage.
